sentences.en: Nadim and Anneena came to play at Biff and Chip's house.
sentences.zh: Nadim 和 Anneena 来到玩在 Biff 和 Chip 房子。

sentences.en: Nadim had a book about the Ancient Egyptians.
sentences.zh: Nadim 有一个书关于这古代的埃及的。

sentences.en: "It isn't just a book to read," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 它不是刚刚一个书到读， 说 Nadim。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "It's a special sort of book."
sentences.zh: 它是一个特别的种类的书。

sentences.en: "It's a model book," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 它是一个模型书， 说 Nadim。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: He opened it to show everyone.
sentences.zh: 他打开它到展示每个人。

sentences.en: "I get it," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我得到它， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "You press out the shapes.
sentences.zh: 你按出这形状。

sentences.en: Then you fold and glue them to make a model."
sentences.zh: 然后你褶和胶他们到做一个模型。

sentences.en: The book had lots of shapes to press out and fold.
sentences.zh: 这书有许多的形状到按出和褶。

sentences.en: Nadim pointed to one.
sentences.zh: Nadim 尖的到一。

sentences.en: "Can you see what this will be?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 能你看见什么这个将是？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "Of course we can," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 的进程我们能， 说 Anneena。 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "It will be a pyramid."
sentences.zh: 它将是一个金字塔。

sentences.en: Chip found some glue.
sentences.zh: Chip 找到一些胶。

sentences.en: Then Nadim pressed out the shapes and the others began to fold them.
sentences.zh: 然后 Nadim 按出这形状和这其他开始到褶他们。

sentences.en: First they made the pyramids.
sentences.zh: 第一他们做这金字塔。

sentences.en: Anneena had a difficult shape to fold.
sentences.zh: Anneena 有一个困难的形状到褶。

sentences.en: "This is a sphinx," she said.
sentences.zh: 这个是一个斯芬克斯， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: They pressed out some tiny trees and people.
sentences.zh: 他们按出一些极小的树和人们。

sentences.en: Biff glued them all on to a sheet of paper.
sentences.zh: Biff 胶他们全部在……上到一个床单的纸。

sentences.en: It made a scene of Ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 它做一个场景的古代的埃及。

sentences.en: The children were pleased with it.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是请和……一起它。

sentences.en: "I'm really pleased with the sphinx," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 我是真的请和……一起这斯芬克斯， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: At last the model was finished.
sentences.zh: 在最后的这模型是结束了的。

sentences.en: It looked so good they called Mum upstairs to have a look.
sentences.zh: 它看所以好的他们叫妈妈在楼上到有一个看。

sentences.en: "What a good job you made of it," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 什么一个好的工作你做的它， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "I like the pyramids and the sphinx."
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这金字塔和这斯芬克斯。

sentences.en: "The sphinx was hard to make," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 这斯芬克斯是困难的到做， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: Floppy ran into the room.
sentences.zh: Floppy 跑进入这房间。

sentences.en: He didn't see the model on the floor and he trod on it with his big paws.
sentences.zh: 他没有看见这模型在……上这地板和他 trod 在……上它和……一起他的大的爪。

sentences.en: He knocked over a tree and crushed the sphinx.
sentences.zh: 他碰撞在……上方一个树和压坏这斯芬克斯。

sentences.en: "Oh Floppy!"
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！

sentences.en: Everyone yelled.
sentences.zh: 每个人感觉冷的。

sentences.en: Floppy looked unhappy.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看痛苦的。

sentences.en: He knew he had upset the children.
sentences.zh: 他知道他有使苦恼这孩子们。

sentences.en: "Never mind," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 从不头脑， 说爸爸。 咳！

sentences.en: "It wasn't Floppy's fault.
sentences.zh: 它不是 Floppy 缺点。

sentences.en: The sphinx looks even better than before."
sentences.zh: 这斯芬克斯看竟然更好的比在……之前。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The key took the children back in time.
sentences.zh: 这钥匙拿这孩子们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took Floppy too.
sentences.zh: 它拿 Floppy 也。

sentences.en: "It's not my day!" Thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 它是不我的一天！ 想 Floppy。 我憎恶船！ 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: "First, I get into trouble.
sentences.zh: 第一， 我得到进入问题。

sentences.en: Now, it's a magic adventure."
sentences.zh: 现在， 它是一个魔法冒险。

sentences.en: The magic took them back to Ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们回来到古代的埃及。

sentences.en: They were standing by a pyramid.
sentences.zh: 他们是站由一个金字塔。

sentences.en: The pyramid was still being built.
sentences.zh: 这金字塔是仍然正在建造。

sentences.en: Far off they could see two more pyramids.
sentences.zh: 远离开他们能看见二更多金字塔。

sentences.en: "This is amazing!" Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 那是使人十分惊奇的。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I didn't think the pyramids were so big."
sentences.zh: 我没有想这金字塔是所以大的。

sentences.en: Some people were pulling on long ropes.
sentences.zh: 一些人们是拉在……上长的绳索。

sentences.en: They were moving a big block of stone.
sentences.zh: 他们是运动的一个大的大块的石块。

sentences.en: "That's amazing too," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 那是使人十分惊奇的也， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I didn't know the pyramids were made with such big blocks of stone."
sentences.zh: 我没有知道这金字塔是做和……一起这样的大的大块的石块。

sentences.en: The "Look over there!" Gasped Nadim.
sentences.zh: 这看在……上方那里！ 喘气 Anneena。 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: She pointed to a huge stone sphinx.
sentences.zh: 她尖的到一个极大的石块斯芬克斯。

sentences.en: "Let's go and look at the sphinx," she said.
sentences.zh: 让我们去和看在这斯芬克斯， 她说。

sentences.en: They all began to run towards it.
sentences.zh: 他们全部开始到跑向它。

sentences.en: Floppy didn't go with them.
sentences.zh: Floppy 没有去和……一起他们。

sentences.en: He had seen a cat!
sentences.zh: 他有看见一个猫！

sentences.en: The cat hissed at Floppy.
sentences.zh: 这猫他的在 Floppy。

sentences.en: Floppy couldn't stop himself.
sentences.zh: Floppy 不能停他自己。

sentences.en: He chased it!
sentences.zh: 他追赶它！

sentences.en: It leaped onto some blocks of stone.
sentences.zh: 它跳跃在……上到一些大块的石块。

sentences.en: Floppy jumped up too, but the cat was too fast for him.
sentences.zh: Floppy 跳向上也， 但是这猫是也快的为了他。

sentences.en: Biff saw Floppy chase the cat.
sentences.zh: Biff 看见 Floppy 茶色这猫。

sentences.en: She called to the others.
sentences.zh: 她叫到这其他。

sentences.en: They all went back to get Floppy, but he was stuck on the blocks of stone.
sentences.zh: 他们全部去回来到得到 Floppy， 但是他是 stuck 在……上这大块的石块。

sentences.en: He couldn't get down.
sentences.zh: 他不能得到向下。

sentences.en: "Floppy, you silly dog," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 你傻的狗， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: The children looked up at Floppy.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们看向上在 Floppy。

sentences.en: "He's a long way up!" Laughed Nadim.
sentences.zh: 他是一个长的方式向上！ 笑 Nadim。 他是一个长的方式向上！ 笑 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I'll just have to climb up and help him down," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我会刚刚有到爬向上和帮助他向下， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Then a man ran over.
sentences.zh: 然后一个男人跑在……上方。

sentences.en: He looked at Floppy and gasped.
sentences.zh: 他看在 Floppy 和喘气。

sentences.en: The man called to some people.
sentences.zh: 这男人叫到一些人们。

sentences.en: They ran over to the children.
sentences.zh: 他们跑在……上方到这孩子们。

sentences.en: At first they were talking and shouting.
sentences.zh: 在第一他们是讲话和喊。

sentences.en: Then they all went quiet.
sentences.zh: 然后他们全部去安静的。

sentences.en: "What are they doing?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么是他们做？ 问 Biff。 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "Why are they looking at us like this?" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 为什么是他们看在我们喜欢这个？ 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The people put their hands together and raised them in the air.
sentences.zh: 这人们放他们的手一起和凸起的他们在……里这空气。

sentences.en: Then they sank down on their knees.
sentences.zh: 然后他们 sank 向下在……上他们的膝关节。

sentences.en: "They are bowing to us," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 他们是弓法到我们， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "They must think we're important." "How strange!" Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 他们必须想我们是重要的。 如何奇怪的！ 说 Nadim。 哦不！

sentences.en: The people were not bowing down to the children.
sentences.zh: 这人们是不弓法向下到这孩子们。

sentences.en: They were bowing to Floppy.
sentences.zh: 他们是弓法到 Floppy。

sentences.en: "I don't believe it!" Whispered Chip.
sentences.zh: 我不相信它！ 低语 Chip。

sentences.en: "They must think Floppy is important.
sentences.zh: 他们必须想 Floppy 是重要的。

sentences.en: I wonder why?"
sentences.zh: 我惊奇为什么？

sentences.en: "A magic adventure is bad enough," The people took Floppy away.
sentences.zh: 一个魔法冒险是坏的足够， 他想， 和现在这个！

sentences.en: The children followed.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们跟随。

sentences.en: Floppy couldn't believe all this was happening to him.
sentences.zh: Floppy 不能相信全部这个是发生的事情到他。

sentences.en: He thought.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇如果。。？ 她想。

sentences.en: "And now this."
The king came out onto the steps.
sentences.zh: 这国王来出在……上到这迈步。

sentences.en: The people took Floppy to the king's palace.
sentences.zh: 这人们拿 Floppy 到这国王宫。

sentences.en: "In Egypt a king is called a pharaoh," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 在……里埃及一个国王是叫一个法老， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "This pharaoh looks very fierce."
sentences.zh: 这个法老看非常凶猛的。

sentences.en: Everyone bowed when they saw him. Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 每个人弓当……时他们看见他。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We'd better bow down, too" said Biff.
sentences.zh: We'd 更好的弓向下， 也说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We don't want to get into trouble."
sentences.zh: 我们不想要到得到进入问题。

sentences.en: A man spoke to the pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 一个男人说到这法老。

sentences.en: "Great Pharaoh!" He said.
sentences.zh: 很棒的法老！ 他说。

sentences.en: "See what we have brought." "The yellow dog!" Gasped the pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 看见什么我们有带来。 看在……之后这黄色的狗， 他说。 一个男人说到这法老。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: The pharaoh took Floppy inside the palace.
sentences.zh: 这法老拿 Floppy 里面这宫。

sentences.en: Then he clapped his hands.
sentences.zh: 然后他鼓掌他的手。

sentences.en: "Look after the yellow dog," he said.
sentences.zh: 看在……之后这黄色的狗， 他说。

sentences.en: "Give him whatever he wants." "Hmm!" Thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 给他任何事物他想要。 想 Floppy。 我憎恶船！ 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: "I'm beginning to enjoy this adventure." Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我是开始到享受这个冒险。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I just don't get it," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚不得到它， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Why are they making this fuss of Floppy?"
sentences.zh: 为什么是他们做这个大惊小怪的 Floppy？

sentences.en: The pharaoh clapped his hands again.
sentences.zh: 这法老鼓掌他的手再一次。

sentences.en: Some people ran into the palace.
sentences.zh: 一些人们跑进入这宫。

sentences.en: One of them began to paint a picture of Floppy.
sentences.zh: 一的他们开始到油漆一个图画的 Floppy。

sentences.en: Suddenly Biff sneezed.
sentences.zh: 突然地 Biff sneezed。

sentences.en: The pharaoh saw the children.
sentences.zh: 这法老看见这孩子们。

sentences.en: "Strangers in my palace," he shouted.
sentences.zh: 陌生人在……里我的宫， 他喊。

sentences.en: "How did they get in?"
sentences.zh: 如何做他们得到在……里？

sentences.en: A guard grabbed Chip and Anneena.
sentences.zh: 一个警卫抓住 Chip 和 Anneena。

sentences.en: Another one grabbed Biff and Nadim.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Nadim。

sentences.en: The guard took the children outside.
sentences.zh: 这警卫拿这孩子们外面。

sentences.en: They took them to one of the pyramids.
sentences.zh: 他们拿他们到一的这金字塔。

sentences.en: The people were moving the big blocks of stone.
sentences.zh: 这人们是运动的这大的大块的石块。

sentences.en: "You all look strong," said a guard.
sentences.zh: 你全部看强壮的， 说一个警卫。

sentences.en: "You can work here."
sentences.zh: 你能工作这里。

sentences.en: The children had to help pull one of the big blocks.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有到帮助拉一的这大的大块。

sentences.en: They had to put rollers down to slide it along.
sentences.zh: 他们有到放滚筒向下到滑行它沿着。

sentences.en: "This is hard work," moaned Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个是困难的工作， 呻吟 Biff。 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: "These rollers are heavy."
sentences.zh: 这些滚筒是重的。

sentences.en: It was time for a rest.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了一个休息。

sentences.en: The children had to drink from a skin bag.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有到喝从一个皮肤包。

sentences.en: "Ugh!" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "This water is warm and it tastes funny too.
sentences.zh: 这个水是温暖的和它味道有趣的也。

sentences.en: I'd rather have an ice-cold can." Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: I'd 相当有一个冰冷的能。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: The Egyptians were carving a giant stone block.
sentences.zh: 这埃及的是雕刻品一个巨人石块大块。

sentences.en: The children had to pick up all the chips of stone that fell off.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有到挑选向上全部这 Chip 的石块那个落下离开。

sentences.en: "This is hard work, too," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 这个是困难的工作， 也， 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "It's no fun being an Egyptian slave."
sentences.zh: 它是不乐趣正在一个埃及的奴隶。

sentences.en: Anneena looked at the carving.
sentences.zh: Anneena 看在这雕刻品。

sentences.en: "I wonder if they are making a sphinx?" She said.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇如果他们是做一个斯芬克斯？ 她说。

sentences.en: "A sphinx has the body of a lion but that doesn't look like a lion's tail."
sentences.zh: 一个斯芬克斯有这身体的一个狮子但是那个不看喜欢一个狮子尾。

sentences.en: "Hmmm, that tail looks familiar," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 那个尾看熟悉的， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Gasped Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: The carving was finished.
sentences.zh: 这雕刻品是结束了的。

sentences.en: "I said it looked familiar," gasped Biff.
sentences.zh: 我说它看熟悉的， 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: "It isn't a sphinx at all - it's Floppy." It's Floppy!"
sentences.zh: 它不是一个斯芬克斯在全部 - 它是 Floppy。 哦 Floppy！

sentences.en: At that moment the pharaoh came to see the carving.
sentences.zh: 在那个片刻这法老来到看见这雕刻品。

sentences.en: Some Egyptians carried Floppy.
sentences.zh: 一些埃及的搬运 Floppy。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: Floppy jumped down and ran over to the children.
sentences.zh: Floppy 跳向下和跑在……上方到这孩子们。

sentences.en: "Come back, yellow dog," called the pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 来回来， 黄色的狗， 叫这法老。

sentences.en: "I'm glad it's time to go," thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 我是高兴的它是时间到去， 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: "It's all getting too much of a good thing." Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 它是全部得到也许多的一个好的东西。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "What an adventure," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 什么一个冒险， 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I didn't like being an Egyptian slave."
sentences.zh: 我没有喜欢正在一个埃及的奴隶。

sentences.en: Anneena picked up the model sphinx.
sentences.zh: Anneena 挑选向上这模型斯芬克斯。

sentences.en: "A sphinx has a lion's body and a man's head," she said.
sentences.zh: 一个斯芬克斯有一个狮子身体和一个男人头， 她说。

sentences.en: "But this does look a bit like Floppy."
sentences.zh: 但是这个做看一个一小块喜欢 Floppy。
